name: spinner
purpose: Shared visual utility used by other components. Lives at `packages/webkit/src/components/utils/spinner/`.
useWhen: An inline busy mark inside a row, log line or custom control that has no loading state of its own.
A small in-progress indicator next to text in a toast or status row.
avoidWhen: A button waiting on its action → set `loading` on `button`, `icon-button` or `button-highlight`.
Content that is still loading → use `skeleton`.
A status with a color and a label → use `status-indicator`.
related: skeleton` — reserves the shape of content while it loads.
button` — renders a Spinner itself when `loading` is set.
bestPractices: It has no props: size it with a `size-*` class (`size-3`, `size-4`) and color it through the inherited text color (it strokes `currentColor`).

class` on its tag is its sizing API, not a restyle: the spec is a `style_seam`, so `webkit/no-style-override` accepts `<Spinner class="size-4" />`. Keep the class to a `size-*` and, when it must differ from the surrounding text, a text color token.
It is `aria-hidden`; announce the busy state on the surrounding element (`aria-busy`, a live region or visible text).
The spin stops under reduced motion, so pair it with text when the wait matters.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Spinner from '@aziontech/webkit/spinner'
</script>

<template>
  <Spinner class="size-4 text-(--text-default)" />
</template>
